description: Object-based Lightning Type schema for E2R Record (v1). Generic example schema — replace or extend properties to match your target object.
title: ahaE2RRecordOBLTv1

senderName.title: senderName
senderName.description: The name of the person who submitted or reported this record. Typically found in the email signature or a 'From' / 'Submitted by' field in the body.

recordDateTimeString.title: recordDateTimeString
recordDateTimeString.description: The primary date/time referenced in the email content. Return as ISO 8601 string: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. Leave blank if not found.

summary.title: summary
summary.description: A brief one- or two-sentence summary of the email content.

category.title: category
category.description: The type or category of this record as indicated in the email (e.g. 'Complaint', 'Request', 'Report').

priority.title: priority
priority.description: The priority level indicated in the email. Use one of: High, Medium, Low. If not stated, use Medium.

actionRequired.title: actionRequired
actionRequired.description: True if the email explicitly requests or implies that an action must be taken; false otherwise.

notes.title: notes
notes.description: Any additional freeform details, context, or verbatim sections from the email that do not fit the other fields.
